# Skillcima

> Beginner-friendly, structured and risk-conscious Forex education through a free five-day foundations course. One lesson is delivered by email each day for five days: a structured introduction to Forex terminology, market mechanics and risk awareness without signals, profit promises or broker recommendations. Forex trading involves financial risk.

## Course

- [Free Five-Day Forex Foundations Course](https://skillcima.com/): course outline, who it is for and not for, FAQ, and free enrolment

- [About Skillcima](https://skillcima.com/about): the structured, risk-conscious educational approach

- [Contact](https://skillcima.com/contact): contact information and support guidance for learners
